items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: So I go down there and play bongos with them... Chocolaté one days says, 'Hey we have a wedding on Saturday and I’m going to have a little bigger band, do you want to play bongos with us?'

ctx.x: Oh okay because your picture is not moving. I think you froze for a second. Anyway, while being at LACC another friend of mine from Santiago said, “Hey man there’s this club down here on Vermont and – anyways and the club was called Chespeako and there was a band with, the leader was the conga player, his name was Chocolaté. I never found out his real name. He was really a dark, black Cuban. Chocolaté. They called him Chocolaté, and his wife Sylvia. And he had a timbale player, a bass player, piano player, he…
Yeah sure go ahead, take our gig.
